svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Transparent mechanical wristwatch movement — animated skeleton
svg.desc: Animated, self-contained skeleton wristwatch movement. A 40-hour mainspring barrel drives the centre, third, fourth and escape wheels; the pallet fork releases one escape tooth per beat and the balance oscillates at 2 Hz. Hour, minute and second hands are geared to the same train. Pause/resume, speed and winding controls are built in.

g.title: Train bridge — carries third, fourth and escape pivots
Balance cock — holds the balance staff and the hairspring stud
Barrel + mainspring — 1 turn every 8 h, counter-clockwise
Centre wheel — 1 turn per hour, clockwise
Third wheel — 8 turns per hour, counter-clockwise
Fourth wheel — 1 turn per minute, clockwise
Escape wheel — 15 club teeth, 1 turn every 7.5 s, counter-clockwise
Pallet fork — releases one escape tooth per beat
Balance wheel — 2 Hz, ±270°, carries the impulse jewel
Hairspring — breathes once per balance swing
Centre seconds wheel — indirect drive, 1 turn per minute
Minute wheel — part of the 12:1 motion work
Hour wheel — 1 turn every 12 h, carries the hour hand
Cannon pinion — friction fit on the centre arbor, carries the minute hand

g.text: every angle is a multiple of the same beat count
space pause · ← → speed · W wind · R reset
watch runs down after 40 h of simulated time
